research_scope: Seven early/base-game skills from PQ41-PQ48. Rolling Bullet is intentionally excluded because its existing PQ42 correction is already canonical research. Quest placement and core classifications/costs are recorded only where supported by current skill-specific evidence; reward-slot and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain unresolved unless directly established.

records.name: Burning Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 41 — Warriors' Annihilation - Future Chapters
records.skill_description: Launches a powerful explosive Ki Blast that sends the opponent upward.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Burning Attack as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki and documents a two-hit projectile/explosion with launching behavior.

records.name: Change The Future
records.skill_description: Counters a Ki Blast attack, then moves toward the attacker and fires a Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Change The Future as a Ki Blast Super and a Ki counter using 100 Ki. The PQ-specific page confirms the skill is associated with PQ43; the available reward transcription lists it among the quest rewards without establishing an Ultimate-Finish-only slot.

records.name: God Breaker
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 44 — Dragon Balls of the Future
records.skill_description: Counters a Strike attack, stunning the attacker before firing a Ki Blast.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies God Breaker as a Ki Blast Super and Strike counter using 100 Ki. Its startup is visually similar to Change The Future but the two counters respond to different attack types.

records.name: Burning Slash
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 44 — Dragon Balls of the Future
records.skill_description: Performs a serial sword attack followed by an optional Ki Blast follow-up.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Burning Slash as a Strike Super using 100 Ki and restricts CaC use to Human and Saiyan characters. The documented sword sequence can be followed by a second input that fires the Ki Blast finisher.

records.name: Taunt
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 45 — Take Back the Dragon Balls!
records.skill_description: A taunting utility technique associated with Hercule that provokes opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: Independent PQ reward transcription confirms Taunt as a PQ45 reward. Current accessible evidence used for this batch does not establish a reliable Ki/stamina cost or more precise technical classification, so those fields remain unresolved rather than inferred.

records.name: Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 46 — 16 of the Official History
records.skill_description: Launches a barrage of Destructo-Discs that cannot be guarded against.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Chain Destructo-Disc Barrage as a Ki Blast Ultimate using 300 Ki, with up to five unblockable hits and documented launching behavior.

records.name: Kamekameha
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 48 — 2nd World Tournament Tag Team
records.skill_description: Fires a faster, weaker Kamehameha that cannot be charged.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill-specific data classifies Kamekameha as a Ki Blast Super using 100 Ki. It is documented as a six-hit, long-range beam and cannot be charged like the standard Kamehameha.
